method: Actual isolated anonymous Chrome with protection ON before navigation, native YouTube player, real ad inventory, read-only 50 ms observations from document start. No synthetic ads, player-response injection, manual Skip, account or personal profile. Browser audio output muted separately from the observed video.muted property.

videos.classification: Real pre-roll conceal/mute and native return observed
No playing ad inventory observed; not counted as a blocking success

limits: Polling observations are not a universal blocking percentage or a unique-ad count.
No zero-frame-flash guarantee is inferred from 50 ms samples.
Real mid-roll and full-video reliability remain unverified.
The test environment still encounters media-CDN HTTP 403 and subsequent player errors; no-extension failure was documented separately.
Cookies, signed media URLs, IPs and private user-supplied video identity are excluded.
